Basic image generation with a text prompt

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createImageRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A white cat sitting on a windowsill\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.imageGenerate(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].url as Any)
```
